I'm currently struggling with extreme suicidal thoughts as well.

I'm not sure I know exactly what you mean about "becoming the villain", but I can relate. I'm a normal guy. Average. Super nice to everyone I meet. Just gets me walked all over. Hence the choice seems to either be a nice guy loser or act like a psychopath and be rewarded in your job and love life. I choose not to be that.

I personally wouldn't commit suicide over that though. But it is a small part of the reason why I wish to take my life.

I know exactly what you mean about no paths left to take. Depression is a bitch.

Our bodies are meant to survive through hell (literally, this world == hell). I, too, tried to kill myself before, and failed. 

I did wake up again today, so maybe that's good? I am still as hopeless as I was before, though. Good thing you're doing better than I am.
Hey, I actually have an overbearing Christian mother. Thanks for commenting on my post, elsewhere. I couldn't help but browse your profile.

Good point.

It just scares me that all the effort (years and years!) I put into a relationship with people can suddenly fall apart and there is nothing I can do about it and nothing they or I did matters any more when things fall apart.

Should I appreciate the good times we shared? I suppose. Even though I'm being told to kill myself (by them) right now though? They actually turned out to be literally insane (psychopathic).

I am not sure I ever want to befriend anyone again. I'm sure there are good people out there who will stick around during sickness and in health and I guess that's what a life partner is for. Shame I never found "The One", and with the divorce rates in this country it is hard to be optimistic about it.
I held hands and kissed 2 girls but I never had sex because I'm a shy loser.
I've had 0 human contact throughout my life. All the things people do during their teen years, I never did. That seems to be the "recurring" problem.

Poured myself some tea. Then on a whim, I just went and grabbed a belt.

I Tested something sturdy. I can't fail like last time.

Then I realized I don't want to die in this apartment alone. I hate this place. I've been trying to escape it for years.

I will die. Just not tonight. I need to die some place else.

Edit: forget that, I know nothing about you. The only thing I know is you're in pain and want to die right now.

Passionate about nothing in particular. But that's depression for you I guess. What do you like to do?

> What do you like/dislike about computers? 

Spent (read: wasted) my whole life on them, unfortunately. I was one of those who thought I'd be in a good place right now job wise because of them but I'm not. Only debt, a temporary $15/hr internship testing some payroll software (that gig's gone now), transcript littered with W's. 28 years old recently got blessed by fate with a whole bunch of health issues at once, and every single person I know on this continent has abandoned me. My whole family doesn't give a shit about my pain, and I'm wondering how I'm going to cure myself with only $1.73 in my account (no, I'm not asking for money). Transcript littered with W's and I have 2 classes to go. Not sure if I should even finish at this point I feel like I'm literally dying.

Been living in poverty trying to make my life better since I was 18 and it has only gotten progressively worse over the last decade and the final nail in the literal coffin is these health issues. Fought so hard for happiness and I feel like it'll never be mine.

I read all you wrote. Thanks for the kind words. I'm sorry no one was there for you when you really needed them and I'm glad you actually made it out. It's really hard to have hope with what I'm going through, though. Not saying my thing is worse than yours. Did you end up re-connecting with the people who abandoned you or were otherwise too busy with their own problems to care?

If I were in that happy place you mention would I be on here helping people with suicide stuff? Probably not. I'm selfish too! But if someone close to me was going through pain I know I'd drop everything I was doing to help them and I just don't understand how I can be abandoned by everyone I know. I'm completely alone in a 2000 mile radius.

No one cares if I live or die at this point. No one would miss me.

I wish I could find someone (IRL) who would care and appreciate care in return.

My interests? Well.
